proposal.description: Copy-paste slip in the delay-flop block: pwm_sync_d is loaded from hiccup_active instead of pwm_sync, so the switching-cycle boundary pwm_fall only fires around a hiccup exit and never while the converter is in S_RUN
proposal.reason: After any hiccup, the clean-run counter never advances in S_RUN, so strike_level stays non-zero however long the fault-free run lasts. Transients that are far apart then add up to latch_assert, when each should have been cleared after clean_run_target cycles.
